items.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
items.summary: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.

insight.digest: 据 TechCrunch 转述，亚马逊与 Meta 正讨论让 Muse 连接亚马逊商城，搜索结果呈现和广告安排仍在谈判。
insight.analysis: 当 Agent 接手商品筛选，零售商需要重新决定搜索排名、广告曝光和售后归属。这些商业安排会影响接入速度。
insight.takeaway: 跟踪双方是否公布合作，以及排名与订单责任如何分配。

items.summary: I gave a keynote at the AI Engineer Code Summit a couple of weeks ago, constructed around the idea that there have been three significant inflection points in the abilities of LLMs and coding agents in the past twelve months. Here's the video of the talk. In this post I'm going to pull out the major inflection point theme and interrogate it more deeply. Coding agents in November 2025 Today, November 24th 2026, is the one year anniversary of the release of Claude Opus 4.5 . With hindsight, this was a consequential model. In the Opus 4.5 announcement, Anthropic said: Testers noted that Claude Opus 4.5 handles ambiguity and reasons about tradeoffs without hand-holding. insight.digest: Simon Willison 用自己的任务复盘模型能力变化，其中一个转折是编码 Agent 的默认产出开始稳定达到日常使用要求。
insight.analysis: 产品能力拐点往往体现在人工纠正次数和任务交付时间。一次成功演示很难衡量日常接手成本。
insight.takeaway: 从真实用户工作中抽取三种高频任务，每次换模型记录首轮可用率、纠正次数和总用时。
